records.jp: 愛央。きららの第六感が、<CR>今日は愛央と一緒にいるべきだって言ってる
records.en_original: Ao. My sixth sense is telling me that I should stick with you today.
records.en_auxiliary: Ao. My sixth sense is telling me that I should stick with you today.
records.en: Ao. Kirara's sixth sense says<CR>Kirara should spend today with Ao.

records.jp: いいよ。でも、一緒にいるって<CR>具体的に何すればいいの？
records.en_original: Sure. Do you need me to like, do something in particular?
records.en_auxiliary: Sure. Do you need me to like, do something in particular?
records.en: Sure. But what exactly are we supposed to do<CR>while we spend time together?

records.jp: とりあえず、東に向かって歩く。<CR>今日は、そっちの方角が良いと出てるのだ
records.en_original: For now, we head east. Good fortune lies in the east.
records.en_auxiliary: For now, we head east. Good fortune lies in the east.
records.en: For now, we walk east.<CR>Today, that direction has come up as auspicious.

records.jp: 分かった。じゃあ、行こう
records.en_original: Sounds good to me. Let's head out.
records.en_auxiliary: Sounds good to me. Let's head out.
records.en: Got it. Then let's go.

records.jp: 東の方角が良いって言ってたけど、<CR>どうしてそんなことが分かるの？
records.en_original: How do you know that we should go east?
records.en_auxiliary: How do you know that we should go east?
records.en: You said east was a good direction,<CR>but how do you know that?

records.jp: そう感じるのだ。<CR>例えば、今日の夕ご飯はオムライス……
records.en_original: I feel it. Just like I feel that...today's dinner will be omelet rice.
records.en_auxiliary: I feel it. Just like I feel that...today's dinner will be omelet rice.
records.en: Kirara can feel it.<CR>For example, tonight's dinner will be omurice...

records.jp: え、ほんとに！？　やった！
records.en_original: Seriously? Score!
records.en_auxiliary: Seriously? Score!
records.en: Really!? Yes!

records.jp: ……の、ような気がする
records.en_original: At least I...think.
records.en_auxiliary: At least I...think.
records.en: ...or so Kirara feels.

records.jp: 気がするー！？
records.en_original: You think?!
records.en_auxiliary: You think?!
records.en: You only feel that way!?

records.jp: でも、オムライスだったらいいなー。<CR>私、ケチャップで絵描くの好きなんだよね
records.en_original: I hope you're right... The best part of omelet rice is drawing on it with ketchup.
records.en_auxiliary: I hope you're right... The best part of omelet rice is drawing on it with ketchup.
records.en: But I hope it is omurice.<CR>I like drawing pictures with ketchup.

records.jp: 分かる。ハートのケチャップは<CR>なぜあんなにも美味しく感じるのか
records.en_original: Totally. I wonder why ketchup tastes so much better when it's drawn on like that.
records.en_auxiliary: Totally. I wonder why ketchup tastes so much better when it's drawn on like that.
records.en: Kirara understands. Why does ketchup shaped into a heart<CR>somehow taste so much better?

records.jp: ほんと、それ！
records.en_original: I know, right?!
records.en_auxiliary: I know, right?!
records.en: Exactly!

records.jp: （独特なしゃべり方、予言めいた言葉……<CR>初めて会った時から、きららは不思議な子だった）
records.en_original: (I thought Kirara was a strange girl when I first met her, with all her prophecies and stuff.)
records.en_auxiliary: (I thought Kirara was a strange girl when I first met her, with all her prophecies and stuff.)
records.en: (Her peculiar way of speaking, her prophecy-like words...<CR>Kirara has seemed like a mysterious girl ever since we first met.)

records.jp: あ、今。メイド服で微笑む詩帆さんが浮かんだ。<CR>詩帆さんとメイド服とオムライス……絶対合うわ
records.en_original: Hold up. I totally just imagined Shiho in a maid outfit serving omelet rice. I bet she'd look amazing...
records.en_auxiliary: Hold up. I totally just imagined Shiho in a maid outfit serving omelet rice. I bet she'd look amazing...
records.en: Ah, just now I pictured Shiho-san smiling in a maid outfit.<CR>Shiho-san, a maid outfit, and omurice... They would absolutely go together.

records.jp: 詩帆なら、クラシカルかヴィクトリアン
records.en_original: The classic maid outfit or one of those Victorian-style dresses would look the best on Shiho.
records.en_auxiliary: The classic maid outfit or one of those Victorian-style dresses would look the best on Shiho.
records.en: For Shiho, either a classical or Victorian style.

records.jp: うわ、それいい！！<CR>きらら、わかってんねー！
records.en_original: Totally! You get it!
records.en_auxiliary: Totally! You get it!
records.en: Whoa, that would be great!!<CR>You really get it, Kirara!

records.jp: （こんな風に、ディープなオタク話が出来るの<CR>めちゃくちゃ楽しいんだよね）
records.en_original: (It's nice getting to talk about this nerdy stuff with someone.)
records.en_auxiliary: (It's nice getting to talk about this nerdy stuff with someone.)
records.en: (Being able to have deep otaku conversations like this<CR>is ridiculously fun.)

records.jp: あ、愛央……足元、危ない
records.en_original: Ao, look out!
records.en_auxiliary: Ao, look out!
records.en: A-Ao... Watch your step.

records.jp: え……ふぎゃ！！
records.en_original: Huh? W-whoa!!
records.en_auxiliary: Huh? W-whoa!!
records.en: Huh... Fgyaa!!

records.jp: いたたた……<CR>なんで、こんなところに濡れた雑巾が！？
records.en_original: Owie... Why the heck is there a wet rag here?!
records.en_auxiliary: Owie... Why the heck is there a wet rag here?!
records.en: Owowow...<CR>Why is there a wet rag in a place like this!?

records.jp: 災いが起きてしまった……むう。<CR>東の方角が吉だと思ったのに
records.en_original: Misfortune... Hmm. It seems I misunderstood the voice.
records.en_auxiliary: Misfortune... Hmm. It seems I misunderstood the voice.
records.en: Misfortune has occurred... Hmm.<CR>Kirara thought east was auspicious.

records.jp: ま、まあ、予言だって外れることあるよ。<CR>……あれ？
records.en_original: I'm sure every psychic is wrong sometimes. ...Huh?
records.en_auxiliary: I'm sure every psychic is wrong sometimes. ...Huh?
records.en: W-well, prophecies can be wrong sometimes.<CR>...Huh?

records.jp: この匂い……カレーだよね。<CR>今日の夕飯カレーなのかな？
records.en_original: This smell... Curry? I guess that's what we're eating for dinner tonight.
records.en_auxiliary: This smell... Curry? I guess that's what we're eating for dinner tonight.
records.en: That smell... is curry, right?<CR>Maybe curry is tonight's dinner?

records.jp: ……また、きららの予言が外れた。<CR>神の声が聞こえないとは、不便なり……
records.en_original: Wrong again... Why has the Divine forsaken me? I can't hear its voice...
records.en_auxiliary: Wrong again... Why has the Divine forsaken me? I can't hear its voice...
records.en: ...Kirara's prophecy was wrong again.<CR>Not being able to hear the Divine's voice is inconvenient...

records.jp: え？　神様の声、聞こえてないの？<CR>東の方角が良いっていってたのに……
records.en_original: Huh? You can't hear it? But you said that you knew we should go east?
records.en_auxiliary: Huh? You can't hear it? But you said that you knew we should go east?
records.en: Huh? You can't hear the Divine's voice?<CR>But you said east was a good direction...

records.jp: 神の声、ここに来てから聞こえなくなった。<CR>外界から遮断されてるせい
records.en_original: Ever since I came here I haven't been able to hear it.
records.en_auxiliary: Ever since I came here I haven't been able to hear it.
records.en: Kirara stopped hearing the Divine's voice after coming here.<CR>It is because this place is cut off from the outside world.

records.jp: つまり、今までの癖でつい……。<CR>決して騙すつもりは無かったのだ
records.en_original: I was really just going on instinct. I didn't mean to deceive you.
records.en_auxiliary: I was really just going on instinct. I didn't mean to deceive you.
records.en: In other words, old habits took over...<CR>Kirara never intended to deceive Ao.

records.jp: で、でもさ！　詩帆さんのメイド服については<CR>当たってるって！　あれ、絶対似合うから
records.en_original: B-but you were right about Shiho! She would look amazing in that maid outfit!
records.en_auxiliary: B-but you were right about Shiho! She would look amazing in that maid outfit!
records.en: B-but still! You were right about Shiho-san in a maid outfit!<CR>It would definitely suit her!

records.jp: ……愛央。きらら、謝罪したい
records.en_original: Ao. I have something to tell you.
records.en_auxiliary: Ao. I have something to tell you.
records.en: ...Ao. Kirara wishes to apologize.

records.jp: 詩帆のメイド服……神の思し召しじゃない。<CR>きららの趣味
records.en_original: I just like maid uniforms. It didn't have anything to do with my power.
records.en_auxiliary: I just like maid uniforms. It didn't have anything to do with my power.
records.en: Shiho in a maid outfit... was not Divine providence.<CR>It was Kirara's personal taste.

records.jp: ……うん、知ってた。<CR>私も趣味だから、オールオッケー！
records.en_original: Yeah, I figured. Me too.
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah, I figured. Me too.
records.en: ...Yeah, I knew.<CR>It is my taste too, so everything is completely okay!
